Lizard Tail Splitter Quirk.name: Lizard Tail Splitter Quirk
Lizard Tail Splitter Quirk.description:
🦎 You turn your body into living pieces you steer through the air.

🌱 At the start you detach a hand or eye, guide it across a room to touch or see, then return it to rejoin your body, leaving your main body exposed.
📈 With training: several routes watched, small objects carried, opponents surrounded, split-body dodges, a full split into up to fifty pieces.
⚠️ Your pieces can be trapped and cannot stay away forever; a hand cannot lift an adult, split views divide attention, and replacing losses drains stamina.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Stamina Drain, as many pieces and regeneration exhaust you.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Setsuna Tokage's Lizard Tail Splitter. You are not related to her; people who know her Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Surveillance +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sectioned Palm, Loose Hand Lift
Lizard Tail Splitter Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: splits off own body parts and flies them. Start: one hand or eye flies across a room, touching or seeing, then rejoins; the rest stays alive, aware. More pieces, joint attacks, wide searches need training; mastery: up to 50.
Limits: a detached hand holds small objects, never an adult; an eye sees only where it points; several views split attention. Pieces can be struck, trapped, stolen; none stay out forever: recall them or regrow at a stamina cost. Split, fewer limbs guard the core.
Quirk Strain: light: one piece, short way; moderate: several pieces, search, restraint; heavy: most of the body, regrowing several pieces; severe: full split, sustained control.
Drawback: built in, the canon Stamina Drain.
Canon: Setsuna Tokage's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Transformation.
Law: user owns detached parts; unauthorized eyes in private rooms violate privacy.
Look: floating parts.
